Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring disclosure of certain information about residential mortgage loans.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to residential mortgage loans; and adding newsections to chapter 31.04 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 31.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Each licensee providing an application for a residential mortgageloan shall give a written notice to each applicant that provides atleast three sources of consumer information developed by governmentalor nonprofit organizations that would assist the applicant indetermining what loan terms would be suitable for the applicant. Thenotice must be in twelvepoint bold faced type or larger on a singlesheet of paper separate from all other documents. The notice mustinclude the mailing address and phone number for the department offinancial institutions and the internet address of the department'sconsumer information web site that includes mortgage borrowers andpredatory lending information.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 31.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A licensee shall provide, prior to the closing of a residentialmortgage loan, a notice to each borrower of the annual percentage rateof the loan and whether or not the loan has a prepayment penalty. Thenotice must be in twelvepoint bold faced type or larger on a separatesheet of paper that serves as the cover sheet for all documents to besigned at closing and must be in substantially the following form:"NOTICE TO BORROWER: (1) The annual percentage rate of your loan is . . .% (2) Prepayment penalty: (a) Your loan has a prepayment penalty of . . .. (b) Your loan does not have a prepayment penalty."
